notes:
## Highlights

- **COMPART STL export**: export either the hull shell on its own or the full compartment model (walls between compartments merged into one plate), and shift the exported geometry to any origin point you choose.

## Fixed

- COMPART Hydro's draft/trim/heel grid heeled the ship the wrong way: positive heel submerged the port side instead of starboard. It now matches Stability's GZ curve convention (+heel = starboard down). Any saved grid results computed with a non-zero heel before this release should be re-run.
- Exporting several compartments together could miss walls shared between adjacent compartments when the two sides were triangulated differently, leaving them doubled up in the file instead of merged into one plate.
